title: Passionate Flamenco Artists.
text: I loved loved loved our experience. The artists performing this art are 100% committed to flamenco and are extremely talented as well. It was one of the best live stage shows we have ever seen. Highly recommend this one. The location and the aesthetics were great as well.

title: PASSIONATE
text: I am not an expert on flamenco but, as far as I can understand, I attended a show by true professionals. The experience was very, very interesting: a passion that hits you right on the skin shines through from the dancers. It is truly passionate. You can feel a great energy. An experience to try, absolutely. A world opens up and an opportunity to delve into this art of immense value.
